text.content:
Prizefighters spend years upon years honing their close combat arts, displaying remarkable skill with a variety of weapons.

SKILLS

Bladestorm

When you perform an attack with a melee weapon, you may spend 10 Mind Points: that attack gains the multi (2) property, or if it already has multi, its multi value rises by 1 (maximum multi (3)).

Bone Crusher · SL max 4

When your attack with a melee weapon deals damage to one or more enemies, you may trade all the damage dealt for one of the following: each enemy hit by the attack suffers dazed; each enemy hit by the attack suffers weak; or each enemy hit by the attack loses (SL × 10) Mind Points.

Breach · SL max 3

As an action, spend 10 Mind Points to perform a free attack with a melee weapon against one enemy you can see. On a hit, choose one option: that attack deals +(SL × 5) extra damage and ignores Resistances, but also ignores non-physical Vulnerabilities; or that attack deals no damage, and until the start of your next turn your allies deal +(SL × 2) extra damage to that enemy.

Counterattack

After an enemy's melee attack hits or misses you with an even Accuracy Result, you may perform a free attack with a melee weapon against that enemy, with your High Roll treated as 0.

Melee Weapon Mastery · SL max 4

You gain a +(SL) bonus to Accuracy Checks with melee weapons.

Oathbound · SL max 5

When you finish a rest, you may swear to protect a creature you hold a Bond of admiration, loyalty or affection toward. Until your next rest, that Bond counts as 1 strength higher, and that creature may transfer up to (SL × 5) Hit Points and/or Mind Points from any loss they would suffer to you instead.
